name: Allpax
old_description: ProMach Acquires DFT Technology GmbH, a Leading Global Supplier for the Thermal Treatment of Food
about:
Allpax is headquartered in Covington, Louisiana, where it designs and manufactures in-container sterilization and retort room material handling equipment. The company focuses on thermal processing solutions for food, beverage, pharmaceutical, and nutraceutical producers.

Its product line includes production retorts, vacuum-cooled fresh product cookers, substrate sterilizers, R&D retorts, automated batch retort systems, and retort room automation. The company also provides thermal processing services, reconditioning, rebuild, and upgrade services for existing equipment, along with proprietary software and hardware for process control.

Allpax serves industries such as ready-to-drink beverages, food, pet food, nutraceuticals, pharmaceuticals, refrigerated and frozen foods, mushroom fungiculture, and research and development. Its customers range from large-scale food processors to pharmaceutical manufacturers and R&D laboratories seeking validated sterilization systems.

The company’s quality policy emphasizes that equipment must “Work Great, Look Great, and Be Delivered On Time.” A longstanding internal slogan states, “The Customer is the Most Important Person In Our Business,” reflecting a commitment to customer success. Allpax says it differentiates itself by creatively applying advanced hardware and software technology to the pharmaceutical and food-processing industries.
